reviews.editorial_notes: Reframed around the pooled observational result, added sample and outcome counts, stated the adjusted risk estimate precisely, and removed unsupported clinical and lifestyle implications.
Identified the 49-person atrial-fibrillation convenience sample, described the design as cross-sectional, and removed causal or protective claims.
Clarified that the warning concerns some notified products, retained the searchable FDA action, and avoided generalizing the finding to every supplement.
